# Front door: working in the hds repo

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-agents-md.mjs from docs/state-surfaces.json (pnpm agents:generate); do not hand-edit. Not shipped in the npm package. -->

@hirobius/design-system is a token-first React product foundation: one opinionated, re-themeable system, published as an npm package, with the token layer portable to other front ends.

## Read order

1. This file, then `CLAUDE.md`, then `docs/ai/NORTH_STAR.md`, then `public/llms.txt`. These are the always-on files: rules, read order and pointers, no state.
2. `docs/ENGINEERING.md`: how the system is built (sources of truth, gates, release, design and code sync).
3. For the task at hand: `public/hds-manifest.json` and `src/app/data/component-api.json` (inventory and props), `DESIGN.md` (visual spec), `docs/guardrails/registry.json` (every gate and where it fires).

## Where live state is

Nothing in the repo records the release, the open work or what is blocked: the ops dashboard derives them. Read its `/ops/standing` (every verdict, from live data) and `GET /api/projects?status=hirobius/hds` (this repo's derived state). No host is recorded here. `status.json` holds only the hand-written focus and phase. Open work is GitHub Issues in this repo.

## Every document

`docs/ai/DOCS-INDEX.md` lists each registered document, what keeps it true and when it was last re-read. Read it to find or change one; it is not always-on.
